title: HyperFlow H3 Flash
description: Animate a reference picture with HyperFlow H3 Flash. Choose normal output or a Deno tiled finish.

controls.label: Keep face (one person through head turns)

requirements.name: HyperFlowGGUFLoader
requirements.instructions: Install the reviewed HyperFlow H3 Flash loader on the local worker.

requirements.name: HyperFlowSigmas
requirements.instructions: Install the reviewed HyperFlow H3 Flash sampler schedule.

requirements.name: DenoMiniMaxH3TiledSampler
requirements.instructions: Install the separately reviewed Deno tiled sampler on the local worker.

requirements.name: MiniMaxH3AddGuide
requirements.instructions: Use a ComfyUI version with MiniMax H3 guide support.

requirements.name: minimax_h3_ref2va_hyperflow_flash_14b-Q4_K_M.gguf
requirements.instructions: Add the HyperFlow H3 Flash Ref2VA Q4 model to the worker's GGUF model list.

requirements.name: qwen3vl_4b_int8_convrot.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Add the Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder (4.9 GB, Apache-2.0). It must be the VL model.

requirements.name: mmh3-4b-ClipProj-celeb-mlp.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Add the 4B ClipProj projection (304 MB, MIT; the author calls it a research proof of concept).

requirements.name: minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Add the MiniMax H3 video VAE.

requirements.name: minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Add the MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

requirements.name: minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_fp16.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Add the MiniMax H3 latent upscaler.

requirements.name: KSamplerSelect
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing KSamplerSelect.

requirements.name: SplitSigmas
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing SplitSigmas.

requirements.name: SamplerLCM
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing SamplerLCM.

requirements.name: SamplerCustom
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing SamplerCustom.

requirements.name: ConditioningZeroOut
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing ConditioningZeroOut.

requirements.name: ClipProjLoader
requirements.instructions: Install ComfyUI-ClipProj (github.com/nicolab28/ComfyUI-ClipProj, MIT; reviewed at commit c01ba8f, version 0.1.13). No Python packages needed.

evidence: 2026-11-06: Normal and HD Upscale completed through CreativeField on the isolated local worker; start/end-frame routing uses the existing H3 workflow.

licenses.software: HyperFlow and the individually reviewed Deno sampler require their respective licenses. Sampling: native-node variant of H3 Image EasyFix (method shared by Reddit user barbear22). Text encoder adapter: ComfyUI-ClipProj (MIT).

weights.name: HyperFlow H3 Flash and MiniMax H3 components
weights.license: Check the model licenses before use.

weights.name: Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder and ClipProj projection
weights.license: Qwen3-VL: Apache-2.0 (Comfy-Org/Krea-2). ClipProj projection: MIT; the author states its legal status is unclear and provides it as-is for research.
